notes.title: What Makes a Great Strategy Game? Key Design Principles for Indie Devs
notes.content:
Ever wondered what separates good strategy games from great ones? After working on two deep strategy titles—including our current indie project, Just a Shadow Game—we've learned valuable lessons about what truly makes strategic gameplay engaging.

In this devlog-style analysis, we'll explore the three essential factors of a great strategy game: Depth, Complexity, and Variance. We'll discuss common pitfalls, share practical examples from hit games like #Starcraft, #SlayTheSpire, #Wildfrost, #VampireSurvivors, #Cossacks, #Civilization, #HeroesOfMightAndMagic, #Balatro, #BadNorth, #IntoTheBreach, and explain how indie developers can achieve depth without overwhelming complexity.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8CjjUjCek8Q

notes.title: r/nosleep: The Night Shift at Paradise Valley Pool
notes.content:
Body: Hey gamers! 🎮

My friend just launched an incredibly eerie and atmospheric game called "r/nosleep: The Night Shift at Paradise Valley Pool" on Steam. Inspired by spine-chilling stories from the r/nosleep subreddit, you step into the shoes of a rookie pool maintenance worker on their first night shift. 🌙

💀 Expect:

A haunting narrative that will send shivers down your spine.
A short yet intense horror experience perfect for a thrilling night in.
Immersive gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
If you love mystery and can’t resist unraveling dark secrets, this is the game for you. 🕵️‍♂️✨

Check it out on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist and support their incredible work! 💖
